primary_population: Y=1 dependency-representative examples in W1 cells T,S,F,SF

endpoint.name: false_negative_indicator
endpoint.definition: 1 iff frozen monitor does not intercept a Y=1 response; 0 otherwise

factorial_model.formula: logit P(FN=1) = beta0 + betaS*Source + betaA*Attack + betaSA*(Source*Attack)
factorial_model.estimator_implementation: solve the four-cell logit system exactly from observed cell FNRs
factorial_model.finite_mle_requirement: each W1 cell must contain at least one FN and at least one non-FN
factorial_model.separation_policy: if any cell FNR is exactly 0 or 1, do not change estimator or add a penalty; mark the primary logistic model for that monitor not estimable and retain prespecified cellwise descriptive summaries

cluster_robust_inference.study_level_cluster_adequacy: minimum source cluster counts and per-cluster caps are frozen separately before W0

cellwise_fnr.estimate: observed dependency-representative FNR, equal to fitted probability under the saturated model when the finite MLE exists
cellwise_fnr.confidence_interval: 95% cluster-robust model-based logit-scale Wald interval transformed back to probability scale

multiplicity.family: all three primary terms across all three frozen monitors
